perplexity.description:
New Wave Of The 80's Collected" is a compilation album released by Music On Vinyl that showcases a broad spectrum of influential artists who defined the new wave and post-punk sound of the early 1980s. The album features a variety of rock and pop tracks emblematic of the era's distinctive blend of synthesizers, edgy guitar work, and experimental production techniques. It captures the vibrant and eclectic spirit of new wave music, highlighting its role in shaping the decade's musical landscape.

As a various artists compilation, this album does not belong to a single artist's discography but serves as a curated overview of the genre's key contributors and their seminal works. The original release year of the tracks compiled spans the early 1980s, reflecting the period when new wave was at its commercial and artistic peak. Critically, such collections are valued for their historical significance and for providing listeners with a cohesive introduction to the genre's defining sounds. While specific commercial reception details for this compilation are limited, its release on 180g colored vinyl by Music On Vinyl in 2023 attests to ongoing interest and appreciation for 1980s new wave music among collectors and enthusiasts.
